claim: Try the product with realistic sample data in a separate demo workspace.
where: landing primary action, demo banner, README
sandbox: fresh Chromium context; open the landing page; follow the one-click demo link; assert the seeded packet and banner

claim: Packet files stay in the browser unless the user exports them.
where: landing facts, assurance strip, privacy page, README
sandbox: fresh Chromium context; record every request while loading the demo and assert there are no third-party requests

claim: Each evidence file receives a SHA-256 fingerprint.
sandbox: hash a known Blob and compare the complete digest with an independent fixed value

claim: Each attached file may be up to and including 100 MiB.
sandbox: evaluate the shared production size predicate at exactly 100 MiB and at 100 MiB plus one byte

claim: The manifest flags missing required evidence.
sandbox: build a manifest containing present, missing-required, and optional evidence and assert every state

claim: Original filenames can be redacted in exports.
sandbox: build a manifest with redaction enabled and assert the neutral indexed filename and redaction flag

claim: ZIP export keeps distinct evidence files even when their source filenames match.
sandbox: fresh Chromium context; attach different bytes under the same proof.pdf name; download and inspect the ZIP and manifest

claim: PDF manifests preserve Devanagari and Japanese packet metadata.
sandbox: fresh Chromium context; export named Devanagari and Japanese fields; extract PDF text independently and compare all fields

claim: A full JSON backup retains packet attachments.
sandbox: create a backup containing a Blob, parse it into a fresh data structure, and compare its bytes and metadata

claim: A fresh device can import a JSON backup before creating a packet.
sandbox: fresh Chromium context with no packets; use the visible import action and assert the restored packet and success message

claim: The app reloads offline after the first successful visit.
sandbox: fresh Chromium context; wait for service-worker control, set the context offline, reload, and assert the app shell and offline state

claim: An existing license provides AES-256 encrypted ZIP export.
sandbox: isolated demo; export with a test password; inspect the AES extra field strength; decrypt with the correct password and reject a wrong one

claim: An existing license can save a checklist as a reusable custom template.
sandbox: isolated demo; save the current checklist and assert it appears as an option for a new packet

claim: A $19 one-time hosted checkout is available for encrypted ZIPs and reusable custom templates.
where: license dialog, assurance strip, terms, README
sandbox: fresh Chromium context; open the license dialog and assert the exact registered hosted checkout URL and visible restore action

claim: Start a packet from cross-border filing, client review, or payment-trail checklists.
sandbox: fresh Chromium context; assert the filing and client options, select payment-trail, create a packet, and observe its checklist

claim: Invoice Packet has no document backend or analytics for packet workflows.
sandbox: fresh Chromium context; record every request while creating a packet and attaching evidence, then assert no third-party request occurs

claim: Invoice Packet can be installed as a standalone PWA.
sandbox: fresh Chromium context; assert a controlling service worker plus standalone manifest display, versioned start URL, and 192/512 icons

claim: ZIP, PDF, and JSON backup exports are free.
sandbox: fresh Chromium context; create a packet and observe ZIP, PDF, and JSON backup downloads without a license
